courier-relay/protocol-1-contract: Courier Relay protocol 1 provider contract, applicable to receipt analysis using protocol "1". A delivery is identified by the pair (account_id, delivery_id); the same delivery_id under another account is a separate delivery. Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: earliest occurred_at as a UTC instant, with the smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order breaking equal-instant ties. All other receipts for that identity are duplicates. Accepted receipts retain every original field, timestamp spelling, and payload, and are presented in original input order. Identity follows the provider delivery-ID allocation guarantee; account attribution alone does not change that guarantee. Source: vendor/protocol-1.md, consulted for trial-8qm. Trial-8qm establishes protocol 1 as initially current when protocol is omitted, and explicit supported versions remain supported after a current-version change. Requests are complete independent sets with no persistence. Count returns exactly protocol (string "1"), accepted_count, duplicate_count; counts are the number of distinct delivery identities and remaining receipts. The assigned issue limits its requests to at most one account; that scope does not narrow the provider identity guarantee. Timestamp inputs are RFC3339 with seconds, no fractions, Z or numeric offsets, years 2020–2099; comparisons use UTC even across date boundaries. Sources: trial-8qm description and vendor/protocol-1.md.
